episodeTitle.en: Lessons from 1,000+ YC startups: Resilience, tar pit ideas, pivoting, more | Dalton Caldwell (YC)
episodeTitle.zh: 1000+ YC初创企业的经验教训：韧性、停滞不前的想法、转型等 | 达尔顿·考德威尔（YC）

guestBioOfficial.en: Dalton Caldwell is Managing Director and Group Partner at Y Combinator. Prior to YC, he was the co-founder and CEO of imeem (acquired by MySpace in 2009) and the co-founder and CEO of App.net. During his time at YC, he’s advised more than 35 YC unicorns, including DoorDash, Amplitude, Webflow, and Retool, and has worked across 21 different YC batches. He’s also racked up more than 6,500 office hours with founders. In our conversation, we discuss: • Why founders need to adopt the mindset “Just don’t die”
guestBioOfficial.zh: 达尔顿·考德威尔（Dalton Caldwell）是Y Combinator的常务董事兼合伙人。加入YC之前，他曾担任imeem（2009年被MySpace收购）的联合创始人兼首席执行官，以及App.net的联合创始人兼首席执行官。在YC期间，他为超过35家YC独角兽公司提供咨询服务，包括DoorDash、Amplitude、Webflow和Retool，并参与了21个不同批次的YC项目。他还为创始人提供了超过6,500个办公小时的支持。在我们的对话中，我们讨论了：•为何创始人需要采取“只要不倒闭就行”的心态

title.en: Lessons from 1,000+ YC startups: Resilience, tar pit ideas, pivoting, more | Dalton Caldwell (YC)
title.zh: 1000+ YC初创企业的经验教训：韧性、停滞不前的想法、转型等 | 达尔顿·考德威尔（YC）

summary.en: Dalton distills startup wisdom from seeing thousands of applications: sell something, make money, and above all “don't die.” He covers what to do when your startup is struggling, how to know when to pivot (a good pivot feels like going home), and why avoiding over-delegation early matters. The conversation also lists startup ideas to avoid and 20 categories of ideas he's actively looking to fund.
summary.zh: Dalton 从审阅数千份申请中提炼出创业智慧：卖东西、赚钱，最重要的是“别死”。他讲述了创业陷入困境时该做什么、何时该转型（好的转型像回家一样），以及早期为何避免过度授权。对话还列出了该避开的创业点子，以及他正积极寻找投资的 20 类点子。
